# AdChanger

> AdChanger is a Mac app that shows one small, still ad in the macOS menu bar, next to the clock, and pays the person
> who shows it for every verified minute. Businesses use the same app to build the ad, choose who sees it and pay
> only for verified minutes. Its first product is MacAd, the menu-bar ad. Operated by Yiğit Ali Kurt; contact
> yigit@adchanger.net. Status: early access (the download is not public yet; join by email).

## Key facts

- Earning: a Mac user keeps 65% of every verified minute: £2.60 / €3.25 / $3.90 per 1,000 minutes (£0.0026 a minute in pounds). An 8-hour working day with an ad running throughout is about £1.25. One person counts for at most 1,000 minutes of one ad a day. Nothing is paid for an idle, locked or sleeping Mac.
- A verified minute: the whole ad on screen for 60 seconds while the Mac is awake and in use. The server checks every minute and accepts it once.
- Advertising: businesses pay £4 / €5 / $6 per 1,000 verified minutes, from prepaid credit; nothing for unfinished or paused minutes; never more than the budget. A person reviews every ad.
- Payouts: through Whop, from 10 in the earner's currency, after a 3-day hold. AdChanger never sees card or bank details.
- Privacy and safety: the app never sees the screen, keystrokes, microphone, camera, app contents or browsing history, and asks for no Screen Recording or Accessibility permission. The ad can be paused, snoozed or stopped at any time. Data is stored in London (Supabase).
- Platform: macOS 12 or later. Anyone 13 or older can earn; advertisers must be 18 or older. UK first, available worldwide.

## Pages

- [Home](https://adchanger.net/): the product for advertisers (default) and for Mac users (https://adchanger.net/?for=earner), with a live demo.
- [Earn on your Mac](https://adchanger.net/earn-money-on-mac): AdChanger pays you to show one small, still ad next to your Mac's clock: £2.60 per 1,000 verified minutes. How it works, what it pays and what it never sees.
- [Advertise](https://adchanger.net/advertise): MacAd puts your brand next to the Mac's clock. Pay only for verified minutes on screen while someone uses their Mac: £4 per 1,000, every ad reviewed.
- [Safety](https://adchanger.net/safety): Who runs AdChanger, which Mac permissions it asks for and never asks for, what data it keeps, how money moves through Whop, and how to stop or remove it.
- [FAQ](https://adchanger.net/faq): Answers about AdChanger and MacAd: what a verified minute is, what it pays, how Whop payouts work, what the app never sees, advertising rules and early access.
- [About](https://adchanger.net/about): AdChanger is a Mac app that shares advertising money with the person whose screen shows the ad. Who runs it, the principles it follows and where it stands.
- [Privacy](https://adchanger.net/privacy): How AdChanger collects, uses, shares and protects personal data in its Mac app, MacAd and website, and how you can exercise your data protection rights.
- [Terms](https://adchanger.net/terms): The terms governing use of AdChanger and MacAd: eligibility, how verified minutes are counted and paid, advertiser payments, ad standards and refunds.
